# Vibe Voice Device application. The baseline demo sources (demo_*.c,
# ui_pixel*.c) stay in this directory for their host tests and as reference,
# but are not part of this firmware: the app has its own UI (vv_ui.c).
idf_component_register(
    SRCS "main.c"
         "vv_app.c"
         "vv_proto.c"
         "vv_text.c"
         "vv_adpcm.c"
         "vv_audio.c"
         "vv_ble.c"
         "vv_ui.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "." "../assets/icons/vibe-voice"
    REQUIRES bsp bt esp_app_format esp_hw_support esp_timer nvs_flash
)

# Generated by tools/vibe_fonts.py (see assets/fonts/vibe-voice/README.md).
target_sources(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../assets/fonts/vibe-voice/vv_font_body_16.c"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../assets/fonts/vibe-voice/vv_font_title_24.c"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../assets/fonts/vibe-voice/vv_font_digits_48.c"
)

# App logos, generated by tools/vibe_icons.py (see assets/icons/vibe-voice/README.md).
target_sources(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../assets/icons/vibe-voice/vv_icons.c"
)
